description: trailing period is stripped by both
trailing comma is stripped by both
trailing closing bracket is stripped by both
trailing double quote is stripped by both
an unbalanced trailing parenthesis is stripped by both
DIVERGENT (intentional): PHP keeps a trailing '!' on a signed CDN url since it can be a legitimate query character; JS strips it as sentence punctuation
DIVERGENT (intentional): PHP keeps a trailing ':' for the same reason; JS strips it
DIVERGENT (gap, not deliberate): PHP has no rule for a trailing '}', so it keeps it; JS treats it as sentence punctuation and strips it
DIVERGENT (gap, not deliberate): PHP only strips a trailing ')' when unbalanced, so a balanced one inside the query survives; JS strips any trailing ')' unconditionally and truncates the url
